content: Ligand 2 is my best molecule but ligand 1 is the working one, so I will convert ligand 1 onto the same winning pattern by a different route, which also gives me a distinct molecule rather than a duplicate. Ligand 1 has the anilide NH already; what it lacks is the aryl-N(H)-azine link, and what it carries instead is a pyrazolyl biaryl at the para position - a motif I have now measured twice at only 0.03-0.05 once the sulfonamide is removed, so it is not pulling its weight. Step 1: atom 13 is the aromatic carbon bearing the pyrazole at atom 14 over a non-ring biaryl bond, so cut it and attach an N-linked pyridin-2-ylamino, the strongest link I have found.
